subject: Reworking upcoming demo into technical scoping roundtable — dates & prework
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>
To: Hannah Boyd <hannah.boyd@fintechiq.com>, Carlos Mendes <carlos@fintechiq.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Reworking upcoming demo into technical scoping roundtable — dates & prework

Hi Hannah / Carlos,

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday. From what you described about the integration points and the team that needs to be involved, I think it makes sense to convert the 60-minute intro demo we had scheduled into a 90–120 minute technical scoping roundtable (engineers + product) so we can map integration touchpoints and define a small POC.

A few constraints on our side: our lead engineer (Rishi) will be onsite the week of Oct 4–8 and then out for travel Oct 9–11, so we can run a hands-on scoping session the week of Oct 11–15 but with limited availability on Oct 12 (late afternoon only). If you have executive stakeholders who are travelling the week of Oct 4, we can aim for Oct 13–14 as the primary window.

Proposed next steps:
- Confirm preferred window (I listed options in the attached proposed_agenda_v1.pdf)
- Share a short prework checklist (we’ll send a short doc asking for current model endpoints, expected request volume, and representative prompt examples)
- Identify the engineering attendees from your side (Carlos, can you add the infra/ML engineer and an SRE if possible)

If those dates don’t work, we can revert to a 60-minute intro and follow up with a separate scoping session — but my recommendation is to do the scoping now so we can produce a mutual action plan by Oct 20.

Attaching a tentative agenda and a blank prework checklist we usually use for scoping.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
aditya@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

Hi Aditya — thanks for the clear proposal and for flagging Rishi’s travel. We do want to pivot this to the scoping format; our product lead (Carlos) and I agree that getting engineering in the room is critical.

Quick notes:
- Execs are traveling Oct 4–7, so that week is tough for sign-off folks.
- Carlos will invite our platform engineer (Maya Lin) and our SRE lead (Greg Torres) to the session.
- We prefer Oct 13 in the morning PT (roughly 9:30–11:30 PT) but could take the afternoon (~3:00–5:00 PT) if that’s easier for Rishi.

I’ll confirm attendees by EOD Thurs. Also happy to take the prework — I’ll ask Maya to paste endpoint configs and expected QPS into the checklist you attach.

Thanks — Hannah

Rishi: can you lead the roundtable and the integration discussion? We’ll aim to cover: current infra, auth/data flows, KV cache considerations, and a small POC scope. I’ve attached the prework checklist and a draft integration notes workbook for your review.

Lauren: can you take point on logistics (shared calendar invite, Zoom + co-hosts, and recording policy). If we keep it to 90m we’ll need a focused agenda and a 15m follow-up for actions.

If Oct 13 morning works for you both, I’ll lock and send a calendar invite to FintechIQ with the attached agenda and prework. If not, propose two alternate slots on Oct 14 morning or Oct 15 late morning.

Thanks,
Aditya

> Rishi / Lauren — looping you both in to coordinate Redwood-side staffing and prework.

Thanks for the heads up. Oct 13 morning PT works for me — I’ll reserve that slot on my calendar and carve out an extra 30 minutes after the main session to capture the POC checklist and owners.

Prework ask from my side (to call out in the invite):
- Representative prompt set (5–10 examples) and expected throughput pattern (peak QPS and average)
- Current model variant(s) and any custom ops/LLM layers you run on top
- Network topology notes (VPC peering, NATs, private endpoints) if you plan to use Redwood Private or Dedicated in the future

I’ll draft a 3-slide tech kickoff summary and share before the meeting. Lauren — can you confirm the recording and provide a shared Drive link for artifacts?

See you all on Oct 13 (tentative).

Rishi Malhotra
Lead Inference Engineer, Redwood Inference
